description.subtitle: Children's T-shirt of the second equipment adidas de Messi of the Argentina 2026 selection - black
description.intro: The adidas Argentina 2026 children's shirt from the second team is inspired by the energy and vibrant character of Argentine football. Its modern design combines fluid lines and intense colors that reflect the identity of one of the most admired selections in the world.
key_benefits: Climatecool technology: Helps keep skin fresh and dry during play.
Comfort for young players: Light fabric designed to move freely.
Official design of Argentina: Inspired by the equipment that the selection looks like.
Material transpirable: Favorece la comodidad durante el deporte o el uso diario.
